item.title: EPCS Prescription Issue ID.me [resolved]
item.description:
Our third-party provider, ID.me, has resolved the issue that was impacting the ability to prescribe controlled substances. Push Notification MFA is now functioning as expected.
Recommended Action: If you previously switched to an alternate MFA method (such as an authenticator app or SMS), you may switch back to Push Notifications.
For steps to update your MFA method, visit: https://support.drchrono.com/home/360051657392-adding-or-changing-a-device-for-multi-factor-authentication-with-id-me
If you continue to experience login issues, you may still follow ID.me’s recovery steps: https://help.id.me/hc/en-us/articles/360017927633-ID-me-MFA-recovery-steps-if-you-lost-access-or-can-t-sign-in

item.title: DrChrono Web System Issues [resolved]
item.description:
We have resolved the intermittent system issues experienced over the past three days. The root cause was related to brief scenarios where one of the supporting databases was unable to accept new connections, resulting in a small percentage of requests (approximately 3%) returning errors.
Overnight, we implemented performance improvements to reduce system strain and help isolate the issue. Today, we made additional infrastructure adjustments to address the connection limitations and monitored system performance throughout peak usage hours. The system is now operating normally.

item.title: Issue Loading Billing-Related Reports [resolved]
item.description:
The performance of billing-related reporting has remained stable following the corrective measures implemented. All reports, including all tabs of the Financial Transactions Report, continue to load as expected. After an extended monitoring period confirming system stability, this incident is now considered resolved. We have implemented preventive measures to reduce the risk of recurrence.
Thank you for your patience while we worked through this issue.

item.title: Prescription Issues [resolved]
item.description:
We identified the issue impacting prescription transmission and worked closely with our third-party vendor, Surescripts, to investigate and resolve the problem. The issue has now been fully resolved.
At this time, prescriptions should be sending successfully without interruption. Our team will continue to actively monitor the system to ensure stability and prevent recurrence.
